The '''JR-4 Recon Droid''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droid]] available during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="LotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The JR-4 Recon Droid first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] expansion to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet. The droid, inspired by [[BD-1]], was available as a mini-pet in celebration of the release of [[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor|''Star Wars'' Jedi: Survivor]], and was gifted to players who logged in between [[April 28]] and [[May 3]] of [[2023|that year]].<ref name="swtor.com">
{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230428|text=Celebrate the Launch of ''Star Wars'' Jedi: Survivor™ with a Free Mini-pet!|date=2023-04-28}}</ref> Some players were mistakenly given the [[B1-SAL Probe Droid]] instead, although this was later amended.<ref name="B1-SAL">{{TORweb|subdomain=forums|url=topic/929094-jr-4-recon-droid-mini-pet|text=JR-4 RECON DROID MINI-PET|date=2023-04-28}}</ref>
